summary.key_takeaway: Global clean energy investments exceeded $1.8 trillion in 2024, driven by massive expansions in solar photovoltaics, offshore wind installations, and grid-scale lithium iron phosphate (LFP) battery storage.

key_innovations: Perovskite-silicon tandem cells achieving 33.9% laboratory efficiency
Bifacial n-type TOPCon commercial panel dominance
Automated robotic cleaning systems for arid regions
18 MW offshore turbines with 260-meter rotor diameters
Floating offshore wind foundations for deepwater deployments

renewable_sectors.dominant_chemistry: Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4) accounting for 78% of utility-scale storage
emerging_alternatives: Sodium-ion batteries for stationary stationary cold-weather storage
Compressed carbon dioxide thermo-mechanical energy storage

policy_frameworks.carbon_pricing_coverage: 31% of global greenhouse gas emissions covered by ETS or carbon taxes
policy_frameworks.critical_mineral_supply_chain: Diversification mandates established by the EU Critical Raw Materials Act and US Inflation Reduction Act to diminish supply concentration for lithium, nickel, cobalt, and neodymium.
